dimensions.name: age_band
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN age < 25 THEN 'Under 25'
  WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
  WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
  WHEN age BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
  WHEN age BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64'
  ELSE '65+'
END

dimensions.name: is_pep
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_pep = true THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

dimensions.name: digital_banking_enrolled
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN digital_banking_enrollment_flag = true THEN 'Enrolled' ELSE 'Not Enrolled' END

dimensions.name: mobile_app_user
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN mobile_app_user_flag = true THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

dimensions.name: has_credit_card
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN owns_credit_card = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

dimensions.name: has_home_loan
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN owns_home_loan = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

dimensions.name: has_personal_loan
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN owns_personal_loan = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

dimensions.name: has_fixed_deposit
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN has_fixed_deposit = true THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

dimensions.name: is_shariah_preferred
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_shariah_preferred = true THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

dimensions.name: marketing_consent
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN marketing_consent_flag = true THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

dimensions.name: tenure_band
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN relationship_tenure_years < 2 THEN '< 2 years'
  WHEN relationship_tenure_years BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5 years'
  WHEN relationship_tenure_years BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 years'
  ELSE '10+ years'
END

dimensions.name: ctos_band
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN ctos_score >= 750 THEN 'Excellent (750+)'
  WHEN ctos_score >= 700 THEN 'Good (700-749)'
  WHEN ctos_score >= 650 THEN 'Fair (650-699)'
  WHEN ctos_score >= 600 THEN 'Poor (600-649)'
  ELSE 'Very Poor (<600)'
END

dimensions.name: overseas_txn_flag
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN overseas_txn_flag = true THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
